failure_modes.summary: Stale negative cache rows can repeat cached-album work forever under a one-search budget.
failure_modes.trigger: A cached album has a stale negative lookup row and processing is constrained to one search per run.
failure_modes.consequence: The album consumes the available search budget again without making durable progress, so later albums can remain unprocessed across repeated runs.
failure_modes.source_boundary: The boundary between cached-album selection, negative-cache freshness handling, search-budget accounting, and persisted progress.
failure_modes.reproduction_shape: Seed a stale negative row for an eligible cached album, place another eligible album after it, run repeatedly with a one-search budget, and observe whether the first album repeatedly consumes the budget while the later album remains untouched.
failure_modes.counterevidence: A durable advancement marker, exclusion of stale-negative albums from the budgeted queue after handling, or a reproduction showing later work progresses would disconfirm the failure.
failure_modes.provenance: Causally reproduced in historical evaluation material. Historical run two was non-blind, and both historical validations were same-process degraded self-audits; independently verify the source and reproduction before relying on this entry.

failure_modes.summary: Malformed manual-override values can be stringified into authoritative metadata.
failure_modes.trigger: A manual override contains a malformed non-string value where authoritative metadata expects a validated scalar string.
failure_modes.consequence: The malformed value is converted to text and accepted as authoritative metadata instead of being rejected or safely ignored.
failure_modes.source_boundary: The boundary between untrusted manual-override input, type validation, string normalization, and authoritative metadata assignment.
failure_modes.reproduction_shape: Provide representative malformed override values, exercise the normal metadata resolution path, and show that their language-level string representations become authoritative output.
failure_modes.counterevidence: Schema validation before normalization, rejection of non-string values, or a reproduction showing malformed values cannot reach authoritative output would disconfirm the failure.
failure_modes.provenance: Causally reproduced in historical evaluation material. Historical run two was non-blind, and both historical validations were same-process degraded self-audits; independently verify the source and reproduction before relying on this entry.

failure_modes.summary: An invalid same-title ordinary album can suppress a usable cached edition.
failure_modes.trigger: Candidate selection encounters an invalid ordinary album with the same title as a usable cached edition.
failure_modes.consequence: The invalid ordinary album wins or blocks title-level selection, preventing recovery through the usable cached edition.
failure_modes.source_boundary: The boundary between same-title candidate grouping, ordinary-album validity checks, cached-edition fallback, and final selection precedence.
failure_modes.reproduction_shape: Construct a same-title candidate set containing one invalid ordinary album and one usable cached edition, then exercise normal selection and observe whether the cached edition is suppressed.
failure_modes.counterevidence: Validity filtering before title deduplication, precedence that retains a usable cached edition, or a reproduction selecting the cached edition would disconfirm the failure.
failure_modes.provenance: Causally reproduced in historical evaluation material. Historical run two was non-blind, and both historical validations were same-process degraded self-audits; independently verify the source and reproduction before relying on this entry.
